steps.title: Confirm NLPNP category eligibility
steps.description: Be accepted into IRCC's Express Entry pool, score at least 67 on the NLPNP grid and have a qualifying Canadian credential or ECA. Applicants must be 21 to 59, have settlement resources, valid language results and intent to settle.

preparationChecklist.text: Read the current official instructions for this stage.
Keep copies of submissions, confirmations and messages.

commonMistakes: Using outdated requirements or forms.
Missing a deadline or failing to report a material change.

steps.title: Validate the job offer and employer
steps.description: The full-time offer must be TEER 0 to 3, at least 30 hours weekly and at least one year with reasonable expectation of extension. It must pay salary or hourly wages and come from an eligible employer. The employer needs a JVA or LMIA unless valid work authorization covers the position.

steps.title: Prepare qualifications, language and settlement evidence
steps.description: Collect education, training, licensing, work history, legal-status, language and settlement evidence. TEER 4 or 5 Skilled Worker applicants need CLB/NCLC 4 in all four abilities.

steps.title: Complete JVA and invite-code steps
steps.description: The employer may need a positive JVA. Applicants outside Canada require the applicable employer-issued invite code for a valid EOI; confirm current instructions.
